verification_instructions: 1) npm run build at root must succeed. 2) npm test at root (shared) stays green (47). 3) cd packages/frontend && npm test stays green (50). 4) Manual/Playwright verification against local `npm run dev` or the live site: click Feed once and repeatedly; confirm exactly ONE sprite SVG and ONE .sprite-bounce-layer remain in .sprite-wrap after the animation completes, and that the feed emoji 🍖 (#10) and the SpeechBubble (#11) still work.
setup_instructions: npm install at repo root (workspaces). Node >= 20. Network OPEN_INTERNET. Playwright power available; `npx playwright install` may be needed for browser automation.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET. No React/DOM unit-test harness, so the duplication fix cannot be covered by a React render test; verify via build + existing pure-helper tests + Playwright/manual DOM inspection. Do NOT add new runtime dependencies. Keep JA output and i18n intact.
contribution_requirements: Work on a feature branch fix/feed-monster-duplication off main. Do NOT push or open PRs (orchestrator handles that). Do NOT touch backup/previous-main. Keep well-separated commits. Preserve the issue #10 feed animation and issue #11 SpeechBubble behavior.
key_patterns: ROOT CAUSE (confirmed by live reproduction): In packages/frontend/src/App.tsx, inside .sprite-wrap, two SIBLING elements receive the SAME React key when a care FX is active: the bounce-layer div uses key={careFx?.key ?? "idle"} and the care-fx <span> uses key={careFx.key}. When careFx is set (e.g. {action:'feed', key:1}), BOTH siblings get key `1`. React keys must be unique among siblings; the collision corrupts reconciliation so when careFx later reverts to null (via handleFxEnd / fallback timer) the old bounce-layer node is NOT unmounted, leaving TWO .sprite-bounce-layer divs (two sprite SVGs) permanently in the DOM = the duplicated monster. A single Feed click reproduces it (1 -> 2 SVGs, stays at 2). Minimal fix: give the bounce-layer a key that CANNOT collide with the numeric careFx.key, e.g. key={careFx === null ? "idle" : `fx-${careFx.key}`} (string-namespaced), so the two siblings never share a key. Verify the bounce still remounts/re-fires on repeated same-action clicks (that behavior must be preserved).
